items.title: [2026-07-09] Sell what you don't use — free (Image Prompt)
items.content:
Editorial classifieds promo poster, coupon/ticket concept.
SCENE: a single oversized paper coupon-ticket floating on a matte charcoal (#1A1A1A) studio backdrop, torn perforated edge with a clean die-cut notch.
SUBJECT: the ticket reads a giant serif '₹0' as the hero number with a small caps 'LISTING FEE' label above it, and a bold '0% COMMISSION' strike beside it.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: a smartphone tucked half behind the ticket showing a minimal qckserve.in 'Post your ad' screen — a photo tile, a price field, and a bright orange 'List free' button; UI clean, real text legible.
COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking only, NO gradients — charcoal #1A1A1A ground, warm off-white #FCF9F8 ticket, single accent orange #ef6723 / #FF6B00 on the number and button.
LIGHTING: soft top-left key light, gentle contact shadow under the ticket, no harsh speculars.
TYPE HIERARCHY: oversized condensed sans headline 'SELL WHAT YOU DON'T USE', an italic-serif kicker 'the free classifieds', tiny footer 'qckserve.in'.
EYE FLOW: kicker -> headline -> ₹0 hero -> phone button -> footer url.
CAMERA: straight-on flat-lay, 50mm equivalent, crisp product-shot focus, subtle paper grain.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, reads at small size, benefit visible before scroll.
Reserve a ~140px blank square in the TOP-LEFT corner for the logo (logo placed manually).
--ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6.1
